name: corr_threshold
description: reduction rule R2: pairs with |r| above this are correlated (only used at full rank)

name: zero_cut
description: reduction rule R0: parameters with influence below zero_cut * max influence are structurally zero

name: eig_cut
description: the ONE rank cut: eigenvalue ratio of the FIM (singular ratio 1e-4)

name: svd_tie_tol
description: reduction rule R1: loadings within this fraction of the top loading count as tied (lower influence is fixed)

name: svd_min_loading
description: reduction rule R1: the null vector is ignored if the top fixable loading is below this

name: multistart_every
description: run a multistart every this many iterations (0 = only at the end of the loop)

name: n_starts
description: random starts of the multistart inside the reduction loop

name: n_starts_stage0
description: random starts of the stage 0 multistart (all parameters free)

name: max_iter
description: maximum number of reduction iterations

name: max_structural_rounds
description: maximum structural fix-and-refit rounds per iteration

name: structural_q
description: rate-level structural check: number of random theta realizations

name: structural_q_out
description: output-level structural check: number of random theta realizations

name: seed_base
description: structural check seed = seed_base + iteration (+ 100 * round)

name: structural_sv_tol
description: structural zero: singular value ratio below this in ALL realizations

name: structural_guard_rel
description: rate rows below this fraction of the median |v| of the reaction use the absolute sensitivity

name: structural_load_min
description: null group membership: diagonal of the null-space projector above this

name: active_rtol
description: output-level test: a free variable within this relative distance of a bound counts as active

name: rank_rcond
description: output-level test: numerical rank cut of the free-variable columns

name: sens_step
description: reduced sensitivities: step h in ln theta

name: sens_step_check
description: reduced sensitivities: step of the column check

name: refit_rtol
description: refit acceptance: obj_after <= obj_anchor * (1 + refit_rtol) + refit_atol

name: refit_atol
description: refit acceptance absolute tolerance

name: final_accept_lr_fraction
description: final re-estimate accepted if obj <= anchor + this fraction of the LR threshold

name: lr_alpha
description: confidence level of the likelihood-ratio threshold

name: loocv_bound_rtol
description: LOOCV fold status anchor_ok if obj_fold <= bound * (1 + loocv_bound_rtol)

name: theta_at_bound_tol
description: a parameter is at a bound if its log distance to the bound is below this

name: tie_rtol
description: reduction rule: influences of a structural null group within this relative distance count as tied (ties are broken by the room to the theta bounds); the output column keeps its historical name influence_tie_within_25pct

name: final_seed_base
description: seed of the final structural check = this + iteration index (the others use seed_base + iteration)

name: perturb_seed_offset
description: rate-level check: the seed of the perturbed-states variant is the seed of the check plus this offset

name: realization_lo
description: rate-level structural check: theta realizations = anchor * exp(U(ln lo; ln hi)) with this lower factor

name: realization_hi
description: rate-level structural check: upper factor of the theta realizations

name: perturb_lo
description: perturbed-states variant of the rate-level check: states multiplied by exp(U(ln lo; ln hi)) with this lower factor

name: perturb_hi
description: perturbed-states variant of the rate-level check: upper factor

name: output_realization_lo
description: output-level structural check: theta realizations = anchor * exp(U(ln lo; ln hi)) with this lower factor

name: output_realization_hi
description: output-level structural check: upper factor of the theta realizations

name: output_perturb_lo
description: output-level check (generic states variant): states multiplied by exp(U(ln lo; ln hi)) with this lower factor

name: output_perturb_hi
description: output-level check (generic states variant): upper factor

name: fd_consistency_rtol
description: reduced sensitivities: forward / backward differences (and the two steps of the column check) disagree if the difference exceeds this fraction of the larger norm (+ fd_consistency_atol); decides fd_unstable

name: fd_consistency_atol
description: reduced sensitivities: absolute part of the finite-difference consistency test

name: multistart_top_n
description: multistart candidate: the best this many non-warm starts of the table are re-run in-process and refined

name: multistart_max_ratio
description: multistart candidate: a start whose table objective exceeds this factor times the incumbent objective is skipped

name: end_multistart_rtol
description: end-of-run multistart of the selection: the candidate counts as an improvement if obj < incumbent - this * |incumbent|
